purpose: Measure the four provisional automatic image-quality candidates on the restricted outcome-free measurement pilot.
input_rule: Only the restricted pilot manifest, v2 canonical-pair manifest, and restricted image execution manifest may be read. No descriptor score, rank, outcome, route, identity truth, historical feature, or manual correction may be read.
image_integrity_rule: Before decoding, verify each source file SHA256 against the restricted execution manifest. Never resize, rewrite, or modify a source image.
reference_environment_rule: Record Python, PIL, OpenCV, NumPy, PyTorch, torchvision, accelerator, worker count, and detector-weight SHA256 before evaluating runtime gates.

measurements.definition: Pixel fraction assigned to the highest-confidence COCO cat instance mask after thresholding mask probability at 0.50; score threshold is 0.50. If no qualifying cat instance exists, record detector_no_subject rather than zero.
Decoded native width multiplied by decoded native height, with no resize before measurement.
Variance of the OpenCV 3x3 Laplacian (CV_64F) of the native-resolution ITU-R BT.601 grayscale decoded image.
Fraction of native-resolution RGB pixels for which at least one channel is <=5 or >=250 on the 0-to-255 decoded scale.

failure_rule: A decode, integrity, model, or output failure must preserve an empty value with the registered status and failure code. Missingness is never converted to zero or manually corrected.
claim_boundary: This protocol measures feasibility only. It does not establish feature validity, individual identity, outcome reviewability, or model performance.
